—repeat, do NOT come down to five. It heard the gunfire, it went through the door like the door was paper—

[static]

—Marchetti looked at a PHOTO of it. A photo! In the personnel files! It knew, it screamed for a minute and a half and then it crossed three floors in—

[static]

—burn the files. If you see a white face in any picture, any screen, close your eyes and burn the—

Attached analyst note: consistent with SCP-096 behavior. Floor 5 containment presumed breached. Under no circumstances forward facial imagery from the Site-104 archive.
